name: 29556 · Kingstree, SC
findings: ZIP 29556 (Kingstree) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29556 (Kingstree) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 29556 (Kingstree) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
